messages.author: eb74a56574cc743b
messages.subject: Make problem Linux CentOS 5.5
parts:
Hello everyone,

I'm trying to solve a problem during make step, but I can figure it
out.

This is the error:

[root@95 rapache-1.1.9]# make

Configuring libapreq2

touch .apreq-config

Compiling mod_R

/usr/sbin/apxs2 -I/usr/include/R -I/usr/include/apreq2 -I/usr/include/
apr-1 -c
mod_R.c -Wl,-rpath,/usr/lib/R/lib -L/usr/lib/R/lib -lR -lapreq2
/var/www2/build/libtool --silent --mode=compile gcc -prefer-pic -O2 -
m486 -fno-s
trength-reduce -DAP_HAVE_DESIGNATED_INITIALIZER -DLINUX=2 -D_REENTRANT
-D_XOPEN_
SOURCE=500 -D_BSD_SOURCE -D_SVID_SOURCE -D_GNU_SOURCE -pthread -I/usr/
include/ap
ache2 -I/usr/include/apache2 -I/usr/include/apache2 -I/usr/include/
R -I/usr/
include/apreq2 -I/usr/include/apr-1 -c -o mod_R.lo mod_R.c && touch
mod_R.slo
mod_R.c: In function 'RApacheInfo':
mod_R.c:1499: error: 'DOCTYPE_XHTML_1_0T' undeclared (first use in
this function
)
mod_R.c:1499: error: (Each undeclared identifier is reported only once
mod_R.c:1499: error: for each function it appears in.)
apxs:Error: Command failed with rc=65536
.
make: *** [mod_R.so] Error 1





What's wrong?

Thanks

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: Make problem Linux CentOS 5.5
parts:
What version of apache are you running? Try this at the command line
as linux distros seem to name their binaries differently:

`apxs2 -q progname` -v

Jeff
